name: evidence-first
description: Require evidence, disclose unknowns, and ask before filling gaps in user intent.

interface.longDescription: A reusable evidence-first skill with local Codex reminder hooks. Reminds the assistant to verify facts, avoid invented details, and ask when missing information determines the answer or action. Reminders do not guarantee correctness.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use Evidence First for this conversation. Verify facts and intent; ask when information is missing instead of guessing.
